severe_conditions: Severe use maintenance conditions are referenced in the schedule but specific definitions (e.g., dusty roads, towing, extreme temperatures) are not enumerated on the extracted pages.
extraction_caveats: 1. This is a BEV (battery electric vehicle) — there is no engine oil, spark plugs, or transmission fluid in the conventional sense; reduction gear fluid replaces transmission fluid. 2. The schedule pages show individual mileage columns (7,500 / 15,000 / 22,500 … / 120,000 miles); repeat intervals have been reconstructed from the pattern of appearances across those columns. 3. The Intelligent Key battery replacement pattern from the pages is: replace at 45,000 mi/36 mo, 67,500 mi/54 mo (page 567), 90,000 mi/72 mo (page 569), 112,500 mi/90 mo (page 570) — this is every 22,500 mi / 18 months starting at 45,000 mi; 22,500 mi is listed as 'inspect' only. 4. Brake fluid under severe schedule appears at 15,000 mi / 12 mo intervals; under standard schedule at 30,000 mi / 24 mo intervals — both are recorded as separate entries. 5. The coolant life expectancy is stated as 125,000 miles or 15 years for the factory fill, but no explicit scheduled replacement interval appears in the maintenance schedule pages provided; this is noted from page 523 text only. 6. Page 574 capacity for windshield washer fluid (Canada) is 1-1/4 gal; US is 5/8 gal — US figure used in the fluid record. 7. The schedule note states: 'After 120,000 miles (192,000 km)/96 months, continue maintenance at the same mileage/time interval.' 8. The Intelligent Key battery inspect entry at 22,500 mi appears only once in the schedule (page 564); it is not a repeating interval.
